mapper.insert: insert into board_table(boardWriter, boardTitle, boardPass, boardContents, deadline, fileAttached, univName, department,info) values(#{boardWriter}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardPass}, #{boardContents}, #{deadline}, #{fileAttached}, #{univName},#{department},#{info})
mapper.select: select id, boardWriter, boardTitle, deadline, datediff(deadline, curdate()) as dday from board_table order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into board_file_table(originalFileName, storedFileName, boardId) values (#{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{boardId})
